# PNEUMA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 1
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic/Functional)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 1-2 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 1

---

[Pages 1-6 of the manuscript are lost. The text begins mid-conversation in chapter 5. Chapters 1-4 are entirely absent from the Coptic manuscript. No Greek fragment preserves this material. The original opening — most likely a post-resurrection setting narrative and introductory dialogue — is gone.]

---

*Translator's Note (PNEUMA):* Nothing survives to translate. PNEUMA does not reconstruct lost text. The gospel as we have it opens in chapter 5.
